luiskr.com / core/utils/canvas/widgets/burger-button-webgl / BurgerButtonWebGL

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/widgets/burger-button-webgl.ts:33

WebGL animated hamburger icon for the mobile burger button. Renders three sleek horizontal lines with rounded pill caps and subtle wave animation. Adapts to the current theme: dark icon in light mode, bright icon in dark mode.

_tryWasm()

_tryWasm(): void;

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/widgets/burger-button-webgl.ts:118

Attempts the WebGPU wasm burger (~50KB artifact, own GPUDevice). MANUAL drive: this class keeps its own loop/resize logic, so the bridge only initializes the surface — state setters and frame(dt) are forwarded by the existing draw path. On any failure the WebGL path runs exactly as before; on success the canvas gets a webgpu context (which is mutually exclusive with the webgl one, so the mount MUST settle before _initGLReal touches getContext).

Re-syncs the drawing buffer to the canvas's CSS box × devicePixelRatio (capped at 2). Only reallocates when the rounded size actually changed, and repaints one frame immediately when the RAF loop isn't running — in reduced-motion static mode a resize would otherwise leave the cleared buffer blank until the next state change.
